content:
# Testament of Levi — 3
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

**1:1** A copy-of-the-words of-Levi, the-things-which-he-ordained to-his-sons concerning-all-they-should-do, and-the-things-which-would-befall-them until-the-day-of-judgment.
**1:2** He-was-in-good-health when-he-called-them-together; for-it-had-been-revealed-to-him that-he-was-about-to-die.
**1:3** And-when-they were-all-gathered-together, he-said-to-them:

**2:1** I Levi was-conceived in-Haran and-born-there, and-after-that I-came-with-my-father to-Shechem.
**2:2** And I-was-a-young-man, about-twenty-years-of-age, when, with-Simeon, I-wrought-vengeance-on-Hamor for-the-sake-of-our-sister Dinah.
**2:3** And-when I-was-returning-from-them, I-was-grieved on-account-of-the-slaughter, and-I-lay-down and-slept; and-I-beheld a-vision according-to-the-vision-of-Abraham my-father.
**2:4** And I-saw-the-heavens-opened, and-an-angel-of-God spoke-to-me: Levi, enter!
**2:5** And I-entered from-the-first-heaven into-the-second, and-I-saw-water-hanging-between-the-one-and-the-other.
**2:6** And I-saw-a-third-heaven far-brighter-and-more-glorious than-those, for-there-was-in-it-a-height-that-had-no-limit.
**2:7** And I-said to-the-angel: Why-is-this? And-the-angel said-to-me: Marvel-not-at-this, for-thou-shalt-see-a-fourth-heaven far-more-glorious-and-incomparable, when-thou-shalt-have-ascended-thither, because thou-art-standing-near-the-LORD; thou-shalt-be-his-minister and-shall-declare-his-mysteries-to-men, and-thou-shalt-proclaim-him-that-shall-redeem-Israel; and-through-thee shall-Judah also-be-made-great.

**3:1** And-when-the-angel had-opened-to-me the-gates-of-heaven, I-saw-the-holy-temple, and-upon-a-throne-of-glory the-Most-High.
**3:2** And-he-said-to-me: Levi, I-have-given-thee the-blessings-of-the-priesthood until-I-come-and-sojourn-in-the-midst-of-Israel.
**3:3** Then-the-angel brought-me-down to-the-earth, and-gave-me-a-shield-and-a-sword, and-said: Execute-vengeance-on-Shechem because-of-Dinah your-sister, and-I-will-be-with-you, because-the-LORD hath-sent-me.
**3:4** And I-slew-Shechem-himself-first, and-Simeon slew-Hamor. And-after-this our-brothers came-in and-smote-the-city-with-the-edge-of-the-sword.
**3:5** And-my-father-heard-of-it-and-was-wroth, and-was-grieved in-that-the-Canaanites and-the-Perizzites knew.
**3:6** And-we-moved-away-from-there and-came-to-Bethel.

**4:1** And-there-I-had-a-second-vision as I-was-sleeping, and-I-saw-a-man-in-white-garments who-said-to-me: Levi, arise put-on-the-robe-of-the-priesthood, and-the-crown-of-righteousness, and-the-breastplate-of-understanding, and-the-garment-of-truth, and-the-plate-of-faith, and-the-turban-of-a-sign, and-the-ephod-of-prophecy.
**4:2** And-they-each-carried-one-of-these-things-and-put-them-on-me; and-they-said: From-henceforth-be-a-priest-of-the-LORD, thou-and-thy-seed-for-ever.
**4:3** And-the-first-anointed-me-with-holy-oil and-gave-me-the-staff-of-judgment.
**4:4** And-the-second-washed-me-with-clean-water, and-fed-me-with-bread-and-wine, the-most-holy-things, and-clad-me-with-a-holy-and-glorious-robe.
**4:5** And-the-third-clothed-me-with-a-linen-vestment-like-an-ephod.
**4:6** And-the-fourth-put-round-me-a-girdle-like-unto-purple.
**4:7** And-the-fifth-gave-me-a-branch-of-rich-olive.
**4:8** And-the-sixth-placed-a-crown-on-my-head.
**4:9** And-the-seventh-placed-on-my-head-a-diadem-of-priesthood, and-filled-my-hands-with-incense, that-I-might-serve-as-priest-to-the-LORD-God.
**4:10** And-they-said-to-me: Levi, thy-seed-shall-be-divided-into-three-offices, for-a-sign-of-the-glory-of-the-LORD-who-is-to-come; and-the-first-portion-shall-be-great, yea-greater-than-it-shall-none-be; the-second-shall-be-in-the-priesthood; and-the-third-shall-be-called-by-a-new-name, because-a-king-shall-arise-in-Judah, and-shall-establish-a-new-priesthood, after-the-fashion-of-the-nations, to-all-the-nations.
**4:11** And-his-presence-is-beloved-as-a-prophet-of-the-Most-High, of-the-seed-of-Abraham our-father.

**5:1** Therefore-everything-that-is-desirable-to-Israel-shall-be-for-thee-and-for-thy-seed, and-ye-shall-eat-everything-fair-to-look-upon, and-the-table-of-the-LORD-shall-thy-seed-apportion.
**5:2** And-some-of-them-shall-be-high-priests, and-judges, and-scribes; for-by-their-mouth-shall-the-holy-place-be-guarded.
**5:3** And-when-I-awoke-I-understood-that-this-dream-was-like-the-first.
**5:4** And-I-hid-this-also-in-my-heart, and-told-it-to-no-man-on-the-earth.

**6:1** And-after-two-days Judah and I-went-up-with-our-father Jacob to-Isaac our-grandfather.
**6:2** And-my-father's-father-blessed-me-according-to-all-the-words-of-the-visions-which-I-had-seen.
**6:3** And-he-would-not-come-with-us-to-Bethel.
**6:4** And-when-I-was-going-to-Bethel, I-saw-a-vision-of-the-heavens, and-an-angel-of-God said-to-me: Why-standest-thou-in-the-holy-place? Enter thou-who-art-holy!
**6:5** And-again-I-continued-forward, and-the-second-time I-saw-a-vision-as-the-former-one, and-these-were-set-before-me-the-seven-heavens, their-height, their-number-and-their-positions.
**6:6** And-I-saw-the-holy-temple in-its-glory, and-the-Most-High-upon-a-throne-of-glory.
**6:7** And-the-angel said-to-me: These-things-are-set-before-thee that-thou-mayest-know-the-things-which-the-LORD-God-shall-do-on-earth, against-Israel for-their-sins, for-they-shall-set-at-nought-the-commands-of-the-LORD, and-they-shall-transgress-every-way, and-they-shall-be-scattered-among-the-nations.

**7:1** And-there shall come upon-you a-man who-reneweth the-law in-the-power-of-the-Most-High; whom-ye-will-call-a-deceiver, but-in-very-deed-he-will-not-be-a-deceiver, but-a-new-priest-whom-God-will-appoint.
**7:2** He-will-execute-a-righteous-judgment-upon-earth for-a-multitude-of-days.
**7:3** And-his-star-shall-rise-in-heaven-as-of-a-king, lighting-up-the-light-of-knowledge-as-the-sun-the-day, and-he-shall-be-magnified-in-the-world.
**7:4** He-shall-shine-forth-as-the-sun-on-the-earth, and-shall-remove-all-darkness-from-under-heaven, and-there-shall-be-peace-in-all-the-earth.
**7:5** The-heavens-shall-exult-in-his-days, and-the-earth-shall-be-glad, and-the-clouds-shall-rejoice; and-the-knowledge-of-the-LORD-shall-be-poured-forth-upon-the-earth, as-the-water-of-the-seas; and-the-angels-of-the-glory-of-the-presence-of-the-LORD-shall-be-glad-in-him.

---
*End of Testament of Levi*
